name: Sylvan Shelter Apartment
description: Sylvan Shelter Apartment is a well-maintained residential community in Maitri Nagar, Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad. The society comprises a single block with 5 floors and 55 spacious 2 BHK flats of 650 sq.ft each, with dedicated parking for every unit. The Residents Welfare Association actively manages maintenance, security, and community events for all families.
